title: Bombay Natural History Society (BNHS)
definition: A pan-India wildlife research organization founded in 1883, functioning as an autonomous NGO engaged in conservation research, advocacy, and public awareness.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Environment Prelims regarding biodiversity conservation, bird migration studies, and institutional roles in national policy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bombay Natural History Society.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
